summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant press against your thinking and how you talk and decide. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: Because this touches Venus, it reaches further than conversation. To feel admired, appreciated, understood is part of what keeps desire alive between two people. When words keep missing that mark, something quietly cools. It is rarely a loss of feeling. It is the slow accumulation of small moments where neither of you felt fully met, until the affection has to work harder to stay warm.
advice:
The work here is not to flatten yourself into someone more agreeable, or to stop saying what is true. It is to get genuinely curious about what this person experiences as care, which may look nothing like your own version of it. We tend to offer love in the language we would want to receive it, and then feel hurt when it does not translate. What lands as tender to you may read as flat to them. What feels honest to them may feel sharp to you.

This is the slow practice the square asks for. Not better chemistry, you already have that. The harder thing: learning how this particular person receives words, and letting them learn yours. Attraction can survive on its own for a while. What deepens it is the moment one of you stops assuming and starts asking, and the other finally feels seen in the exact place they kept getting missed.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant press against your thinking and how you talk and decide.
